title: Being etale descends along fpqc coverings (Stacks 02VN)
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $\{g_i:S_i\to S\}_{i\in I}$ be an fpqc covering of $S$ [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. For $i\in I$ let $f_i:X\times_SS_i\to S_i$ be the base change of $f$ along $g_i$, the second projection of the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product]. If $f_i$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] for every $i\in I$, then $f$ is etale.

source.place: Descent, Lemma Tag 02VN (lemma-descending-property-etale, line 6209: 'The property P(f) = "f is etale" is fpqc local on the base'), the direction 'each base change has the property => f has it' of Definition Tag 02KO (definition-property-morphisms-local, line 5310); its proof: etale = flat and G-unramified (Morphisms, Lemma Tag 02GV), and both are fpqc local on the base (Lemmas Tag 02L2, 02VM)

proof.text: *The base changes are flat, locally of finite presentation and unramified.* For every $i\in I$ the morphism $f_i:X\times_SS_i\to S_i$ is etale, i.e. by [def-weil-etale-morphism] it is locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and unramified [def-weil-unramified-morphism]. (This is the decomposition 'etale = flat and G-unramified' of Morphisms, Lemma 02GV used by the source: G-unramified means locally of finite presentation with $\Omega=0$, i.e., by Morphisms 02GE, locally of finite presentation with open diagonal immersion, i.e. locally of finite presentation and unramified in the sense of [def-weil-unramified-morphism]; in the DAG this is the definition [def-weil-etale-morphism] itself, so no lemma is needed.)

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma Tag 02GV (lemma-flat-unramified-etale, line 8405), cited in the proof of Descent 02VN

proof.text: *Flatness descends (Descent 02L2).* By step 1 every $f_i$ is flat and $\{g_i:S_i\to S\}_{i\in I}$ is an fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering], so $f$ is flat by [lem-weil-pbc-fpqc-descend-flat] (applied to $f$ and the same covering).

source.place: proof of Lemma Tag 02VN (line 6214): 'being flat ... fpqc local on the base (Lemma 02L2)'

proof.text: *Local finite presentation descends (Descent 02KY, the 'locally of finite presentation' half of G-unramified in 02VM).* By step 1 every $f_i$ is locally of finite presentation, so $f$ is locally of finite presentation by [lem-weil-pbc-fpqc-descend-locally-finite-presentation] (applied to $f$ and the same fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]).

source.place: proof of Lemma Tag 02VN: 'G-unramified ... fpqc local on the base (Lemma 02VM)', whose proof for G-unramified uses Lemma Tag 02KY (lemma-descending-property-locally-finite-presentation, line 5767)

proof.text: *Being unramified descends (Descent 02VM).* By step 1 every $f_i$ is unramified, so $f$ is unramified by [lem-galois-fpqc-descend-unramified] (applied to $f$ and the same fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]).

source.place: proof of Lemma Tag 02VN: 'G-unramified ... fpqc local on the base (Lemma 02VM, lemma-descending-property-unramified, line 6187)'

proof.text: *Conclusion.* By steps 2, 3 and 4, $f$ is flat, locally of finite presentation and unramified, i.e. etale by [def-weil-etale-morphism] (flat and G-unramified, Morphisms 02GV, read backwards).
